dataset.name: WUSTL pretreatment cervical-cancer cohort (GSE151666)
dataset.description: Independent cervical-cancer cohort with whole-transcriptome bulk RNA sequencing and individual overall-survival follow-up.
dataset.cohort_context: Washington University School of Medicine profiled 68 pretreatment primary cervical cancers by bulk RNA sequencing. TRACE Explorer links every GEO sample to the individual overall-survival record later published as source data for Fowle-Grider et al. The companion GSE275914 release contains different patients and remains a separate analysis option.
dataset.publication_citation: Zhang et al. Journal of Clinical Investigation 2021; Fowle-Grider et al. Nature 2024

metadata.source_program: Washington University School of Medicine cervical-cancer tumor bank
metadata.source_data_system: NCBI Gene Expression Omnibus plus pinned Springer Nature source data
metadata.library_method: Whole-transcriptome RNA sequencing of pretreatment primary cervical tumors; approximately 40 million 1 x 50 nt reads per sample, aligned to GRCh38 with STAR 2.7.0f
metadata.endpoint_context: Source-published overall survival; Figure 2g defines the follow-up scale in months
metadata.endpoint_caveat: The source-data workbook labels follow-up as FUtime.DeathTime and the accompanying figure labels the axis in months, but the exact clinical time origin is not stated. TRACE Explorer therefore does not claim diagnosis-, treatment- or surgery-anchored harmonization.
metadata.clinical_evidence_note: The pinned Nature source-data workbook contains 99 individual records. A prespecified library-key pattern selects exactly the 68 large_ and pilot_ records belonging to GSE151666. Each key is independently encoded in the corresponding GEO supplementary filename and appears as one expression-matrix column.
metadata.sample_selection_note: All retained samples are source-designated pretreatment primary cervical cancers, with one RNA profile and one endpoint record per patient.
metadata.overlap_note: GSE151666 contains CxCC_01 through CxCC_68. GSE275914 contains CxCC_69 through CxCC_99 and distinct third_ library keys. The releases are not pooled and no patient identifiers overlap.
metadata.redistribution_note: TRACE Explorer downloads and transforms the pinned public files in place. Source-file redistribution is disabled; NCBI GEO and Springer Nature terms remain controlling.

samples.sample_role: Pretreatment primary cervical-cancer tumor, one bulk RNA profile per patient

expression.label: WUSTL gene-level FPKM transformed to log2(FPKM + 1)
expression.mapping_source: Source-provided gene_name column in the pinned GEO matrix
expression.duplicate_feature_rationale: The pinned matrix contains 302 case-insensitive symbols represented by 2,047 rows. All occurrences of those ambiguous symbols are excluded before canonicalization; the remaining 56,332 symbols are unique and retain source row order.
expression.scale_note: The source supplies gene-level FPKM. TRACE Explorer selects endpoint-linked columns, excludes every case-insensitive duplicated symbol rather than averaging distinct source features, and applies log2(FPKM + 1).

endpoints.label: Source-provided overall survival
endpoints.event_definition: Death from any cause as encoded by DeathCensor (1 = death; 0 = censored)
